kind: local CPU and V8 allocation-sampling replay, not a competitor benchmark
scope: new proxy spill identity each round, stable within its six requests
limitations: One local replay pair; no confidence interval or competitor CPU/allocation trace.
Disk spill writes, network, request parsing and provider inference are excluded.
Sampled allocated bytes are estimates, not exact totals or retained heap.
Equal length checksums alone do not prove equal content; separate byte-equivalence and protocol checks are required.
The cache trades bounded retained memory for less repeated work: 8 MiB string budget and 128 entries per proxy.
